prompts.name: head
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is ONLY for character identity, outfit and cel shading; do not reproduce its 3/4 pose or layout. Create ONE isolated 2D cutout animation part, strict orthographic SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, for a lean young adult male hero. Clean professional hand-inked cel animation art, smooth crisp very dark charcoal contour, flat local colors and exactly ONE hard-edged shadow color per material, no gradients/no texture/no pixel art/no glow/no text/no labels/no drop shadows. Light from upper right. Real transparent background. Fill canvas with the requested single part with a little transparent margin. All vertical limb axes must be perfectly vertical, not bent or slanted. Joint caps must be rounded filled overlaps, not cut flat, sockets or hollow rings. Outfit: muted medium grey hooded jacket, dark navy cargo pants, off-white sneakers, black messy hair, tan skin, cracked muted teal AR goggles; compact straight single-edged knife. Proportions for a roughly 512px tall figure: head including neck about 108px, torso about 154px, pelvis 57px, shoulder-to-elbow 78px, elbow-to-knuckles 100px, hip-to-knee 110px, knee-to-sole 126px. Match reference closely in the visible detailing but keep simple. Draw ONLY head + messy black hair + cracked teal AR goggles and short neck. Strict RIGHT-facing 90 degree side profile: ONE visible ear, single visible lens in profile, projecting nose/chin at right, rear of skull at left. Hair has broad pointed messy locks. Calm focused closed mouth, no beard. Include a short tan neck ending in a rounded base below jaw that can overlap into hoodie neck socket. No clothing, no shoulders, no torso. Desired final aspect about 90 wide x 110 high.
